name: Local Qwen general source-grounding context AB v1
description: Matched same-seed comparison across nine task shapes excluded from the scheduler/retry/channel tuning cohort. Treatments either place literal task-named source in the opening reasoning context or spend one fresh reasoning pass after those paths have been inspected. Seven fixtures name concrete source files and can activate the treatment; the two directory-only adapter tasks are intentional unchanged negative controls. Neither treatment adds a semantic contract, task classifier, verification trigger, or action mask. Full API/request and execution-state shadow evidence is retained.

arms.name: control
arms.description: Current general BANTAM context with literal task-path preloading disabled.

arms.name: post-inspection-synthesis
arms.description: After all literal task-named source paths are resident, spend one fresh reasoning pass before the first edit.

arms.name: literal-path-opening-context
arms.description: Put existing source paths explicitly named by the task into the opening context so turn-zero reasoning is source-grounded.
